PROBLEMSENCOUNTERED:

2008-01-17 317 m MD Namsang/ wellbore_instability1medium / 4.5 hrs NPT
Cause: Hole instability / cavings on surface while drilling Namsang, tight hole on connections.
Remedy: Increased mud weight and viscosity, short-tripped to condition hole.

2008-01-17 /326 m MD IGirujan I cementing_issue1 high I19.0 hrs NPT
Cause: Excessive cement losses to formation while cementing across Girujan.
Remedy: staged cement job with lightweight lead slurry and full tail string.

2008-01-18 / 683 m MD IGirujan /stuck_pipeIhigh /12.9 hrs NPT
Cause: Differential sticking in Girujan, no rotation or reciprocation possible.
Remedy: Reduced mud weight, spotted spotting fluid across pay zone, freed string on jarring.

2008-01-19/1160m MD/Tipam1mud1oss/medium /2.2hrs NPT
Cause: Losses seen while running casing through Tipam, static losses continuing on connections.
Remedy: Spotted 83 bbl high-fluid-loss pill across the loss zone and monitored pit levels.

2008-01-19/ 1168 m MD Tipam/mud 1ossImedium/ 3.7hrs NPT
Cause: Losses seen while running casing through Tipam, static losses continuing on connections.
Remedy: Spotted 28 bbl high-fluid-loss pill across the loss zone and monitored pit levels.

2008-01-19|1221 mMDTipam /mud_loss /medium/2.0 hrs NPT
Cause: Total losses encountered in Tipam, no returns to surface for 2.0 hrs.
Remedy: Pumped cement plug to seal loss zone, waited on cement, tested integrity before resuming.

2008-01-21 /2248 m MD /Barail /stuck_pipeImediumI 7.1 hrs NPT
Cause: Differential sticking in Barail, no rotation or reciprocation possible.

2008-01-23 /2997 m MD |Basement Itorque_spike/ medium / 9.3 hrs NPT

Remedy: Reduced woB and RpM, reamed interval, resumed drilling at reduced parameters.
